question: Methyl ethyl ketone is also known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2-butanone.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Methyl ethyl ketone:-**

 
 
• **It is also known as 2-butanone.**
 
• It is an organic compound with the formula CH₃C(O)CH₂CH₃.
 
• It is a colorless, flammable liquid with a sharp, acetone-like odor.
 
• MEK is miscible with water and most organic solvents.
 
• It is a common industrial solvent and is used in a variety of applications, including the production of resins, plastics, and synthetic rubber.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Propanone:-**

 
 
• **It is also known as acetone.**
 
• It is a colorless, flammable liquid with a sharp, acetone-like odor.
 
• It is miscible with water and most organic solvents.
 
• Propanone is a common industrial solvent and is used in a variety of applications, including the production of resins, plastics, and synthetic rubber.
 
 
 
• **Methyl pentanone:-**
 
 
• **It is also known as 4-methyl-2-pentanone.**
 
• It is a colorless, flammable liquid with a camphor-like odor.
 
• It is miscible with water and most organic solvents.
 
• Methyl pentanone is used as a solvent, a paint thinner, and in the production of resins and plastics.
 
 
 
• **2-butanol:-**
 
 
• **It is also known as sec-butyl alcohol.**
 
• It is a colorless, flammable liquid with a mild, musty odor.
 
• It is miscible with water and most organic solvents. 2-butanol is used as a solvent, a degreaser, and in the production of synthetic rubber and esters.
